title: Climate Change Risk and Vulnerability Assessment: Trelawny
organization: UN Capital Development Fund (UNCDF) and UNDP Jamaica, with the Green Climate Fund and Trelawny Municipal Corporation
temporal_coverage: Report dated 10 August 2025; community risk and adaptive-capacity assessment with historical hazard records and projections through 2059.
methodology: Parish CRVA combines hazard, exposure, sensitivity and adaptive-capacity indices, with stakeholder validation.
limitations: The report notes gaps in localized data and long-term projections; recommendations are not measured outcomes.

title: Climate Change Risk and Vulnerability Assessment: Westmoreland
organization: UN Capital Development Fund (UNCDF) and UNDP Jamaica, with the Green Climate Fund and Westmoreland Municipal Corporation
temporal_coverage: Report dated 10 August 2025; historical hazard records and downscaled projections for 2030–2039, 2040–2049 and 2050–2059.
methodology: Parish CRVA combines hazard, exposure, sensitivity and adaptive-capacity indices, with stakeholder validation.
limitations: The report notes western-region projection gaps; options are proposals.

title: Jamaica Systematic Country Diagnostic: Boosting Recovery and Sustainable Economic Growth
temporal_coverage: Country diagnostic published in 2022, drawing on historical disaster, household, labor-market and social evidence available to the assessment.
methodology: Country diagnostic synthesizes Jamaican economic, social, household and climate-risk evidence.
limitations: Evidence largely predates 2022; no climate-caused violence finding.

title: Jamaica's Progress Towards Implementation of Key Climate Change Adaptation Actions and Plans
temporal_coverage: Performance audit of climate-adaptation planning and implementation during 2018/19–2024/25; selected project statuses are dated October 2025 or January 2026.
methodology: Independent performance audit reviewed ministry records, project status, coordination, stakeholder engagement and monitoring.
limitations: Findings describe the audit period and stated cut-off dates, not implementation status after January 2026.

title: LG-ACT Project Brief
organization: Ministry of Local Government and Community Development, Government of Jamaica
geographic_coverage: urban communities served by municipal water systems
temporal_coverage: Undated government project brief; describes planned activities over a stated 27-month project period.
methodology: Government project brief describes objectives, components and expected outcomes.
limitations: The page gives no publication date or current status; expected outcomes do not demonstrate completed work.

title: Parish Safety and Security Mechanism
organization: Ministry of Local Government and Community Development, Government of Jamaica
temporal_coverage: Undated government description of the parish-level safety and security mechanism.
methodology: Ministry page describes committee mandates, participation and coordination functions.
limitations: The page is undated and documents institutional design, not current operation or outcomes.

title: Approach Paper: Jamaica Country Program Evaluation, Fiscal Years 2014–25
organization: World Bank Group, Independent Evaluation Group
temporal_coverage: December 2025 evaluation approach-paper context; not completed evaluation results.
methodology: Evaluation approach paper synthesizing country context.
limitations: Contextual diagnosis, not a completed impact evaluation or local causal estimate.
